Supreme Court Questions Shiv Sena Symbol Allocation to Shinde Faction

The Supreme Court of India questioned the Eknath Shinde faction's claim to the Shiv Sena party symbol, referring to the act of defection as a 'constitutional sin'. The court's query was directed at the legitimacy of allocating the symbol to a group accused of such defection.
